subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should the Android app ship a dedicated built-in composer dictation control, rather than continuing to rely on Voice Note, Talk, or device keyboard dictation?
rationale: The implementation adds a persistent user-facing feature and changes microphone ownership and send admission; code review cannot determine whether this is the intended Android product surface.

options.title: Sponsor after complete proof
options.body: Keep the feature direction and merge only after a recognizer-enabled real-device or emulator recording proves transcript insertion and the intended owner/microphone safety behavior.

options.title: Decline built-in dictation
options.body: Close the PR if Android should remain limited to existing Voice Note, Talk, and platform keyboard dictation paths.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after complete proof
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction and merge only after a recognizer-enabled real-device or emulator recording proves transcript insertion and the intended owner/microphone safety behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Assigned reviewer and recent contributor to the Android composer ownership surface.
